description: The Goma sit-in before the governor’s office is verified, but Radio Okapi gives no total attendance. Its report of about ten arrests is not crowd size.
required_followup: Find a contemporaneous attendance account or organizer record; do not use arrest counts as turnout. Also seek a physical end time.

description: The Butembo teachers’ assembly has only a search-result preview reporting more than 250 teachers. The article body, venue, public/open status, government target, and figure are unverified; labor stoppages do not by themselves establish a public assembly.
required_followup: After a fresh exact-source access review, seek the permitted article body or dated union/school records confirming whether an open assembly occurred, its attendance, demands, target, and physical duration.

description: Anadolu’s opened Goma Jan 18 report says “dozens” and describes opposition to EAC regional-force inaction. The phrase does not establish 50; the report does not settle whether participants demanded action from the Congolese government or addressed only the regional force.
required_followup: Seek permitted contemporaneous local reporting or organizer documents identifying the direct target and a simultaneous crowd estimate. Keep search-only claims and shared-origin uncertainty separate from the opened account.

description: Top Info search results describe a Jan 21 Butembo march but give no attendance. The exact article open returned Cache miss; the grievance concerns the EAC force and its direct target in Congolese policy is unresolved.
required_followup: Use a permitted source body or independent local report to verify occurrence, turnout, exact demand/target, organizer, and physical end.

description: RTVH search results describe a Jan 21 Beni march and an appeal for the Congolese government to equip FARDC, but no turnout is given and no body was retrieved. Cache miss and DNS failure are technical outcomes, not denials.
required_followup: Find permitted body evidence or contemporaneous independent local reporting that confirms the event, demand, attendance, and state response.

description: Opened Actualite.cd and Enquete.cd reports place the Ensemble march in Lubumbashi on 19 January; a search-only Radio Okapi result gives 20 January. Actualite attributes arrest and beating claims to a party official; Enquete says its sources reported no arrests or deaths. The grievance is directed at statements by a serving minister/governing-camp politicians, while the march was party-organized; review the exact partisan/electoral exclusion in the original manual.
required_followup: Reconcile the day and whether all reports describe the same episode; seek independent reporting on arrests, beatings and deaths; apply the original manual to the documented government-conduct grievance.

description: The search-only records for Beni and Butembo report separate local anti-EAC marches on 21 January; similar “Lisanga” naming does not prove common organization or one coordinated multi-city event. The two physical locations are retained separately.
required_followup: Compare organizer statements and dated reports before linking or consolidating the local actions; do not merge by date or similar organization names alone.

description: A Goma press briefing was reported on 23 January with a call for a 26 January “ville morte” action, described as continuing the Jan 18 mobilization. An announcement is not proof the physical action occurred. Later February action reporting does not establish January 26 execution or continuity.
required_followup: Find a contemporaneous dated report of actual Jan 26 participation and physical action before creating a candidate or continuation; keep February events outside this unit absent continuity evidence.

description: All six candidate records lack a sourced physical end time/date. Publication dates, strike notices, announced plans, a temporary promise to respond, and dates of last observation are not coded as physical ends. The strike leads in Goma and Butembo do not establish a >=50 public assembly or verified connection to the Butembo Jan 11 assembly.
required_followup: Check dated reporting before and after January for each candidate’s physical closure or recurrence; distinguish public assemblies from work stoppages and announcements.

description: Thirteen exact-URL web.open attempts are retained: four returned article bodies and nine returned Cache miss with no HTTP response. Three subsequent ordinary HTTPS attempts (ACP, RTVH, Radio Okapi) failed DNS resolution before HTTP. Cache misses and DNS failures are technical retrieval outcomes, not publisher denials. AP and Africa-Press cards stayed search-only under inherited holds.
required_followup: Preserve all source holds; use the named receipt for any newly authorized body attempt and do not retry a held publisher or infer denial from technical failures.

description: Many discovery results for Goma and Lubumbashi may repeat statements or reporting from shared origins. Search-result repetition across outlet names does not establish independent corroboration; body and origin lineage are not verified for the search-only cards.
required_followup: Review bylines, cited agencies, and written origins from permitted source bodies before treating accounts as independent.

description: The bounded pass captured eight actual grouped search invocations and 243 ordered result headers, using French and English plus limited Swahili terms, country/regional/sector searches, and four weekly January windows. Results emphasized Goma, Butembo, Beni and Lubumbashi; Kinshasa, Bukavu and other provinces were not systematically covered. No LexisNexis-equivalent or broad local newspaper archive was reviewed. This scope cannot establish absence or exhaustiveness.
required_followup: Continue with fluent local-language and provincial archive research, including central/western cities and sectors not covered; treat this pass as bounded discovery only.

description: No verified continuation from December 2022 or into February 2023 is established for the January candidate events. The Jan 26 Goma call and a later February “ville morte” report are not merged without physical execution and episode evidence.
required_followup: Check adjacent-month reporting for each event’s onset, recurrence or physical continuation, and retain null endpoints unless an actual end is reported.

description: The official Mass Mobilization baseline/version, country universe, schema, reuse terms and any additional author coding procedure remain pending coordinator verification. These are provisional separate research candidates with no official IDs or approval.
required_followup: Coordinator to verify the current authoritative baseline, version/cutoff, schema, license and additional procedure before compatibility decisions or contribution.
